description: Dashboard polish for the admin Marketing Center (frontend only, independent of FEAT-002): make three StatCards clickable + keyboard-accessible, add a once-per-day bilingual suggestion nudge banner driven by the live fetchMarketingDashboard data, and add friendly mobile-friendly primary CTA buttons that deep-link into sub-tabs. All edits are in web/src/pages/admin/AdminMarketing.tsx plus one new nudge component. Preserve the inline-style design system (card, btnPrimary, btnGhost, muted, etc.), the bilingual Hindi+English copy, and the existing 'link opened != sent' disclaimer. No new dependencies.
steps: In web/src/pages/admin/AdminMarketing.tsx, extend the StatCard component props with optional `onClick?: () => void` and optional `ariaLabel?: string`. When onClick is present render the card with role="button", tabIndex={0}, cursor:'pointer', a subtle hover effect (inline onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave toggling boxShadow/transform is fine), aria-label={ariaLabel ?? label}, and an onKeyDown that invokes onClick on Enter or Space (preventDefault for Space). When onClick is absent, render exactly as today (plain div, no role/cursor). Keep the `warn` styling unchanged. Keep tap target >=40px (padding 14 already satisfies this).

In the Dashboard() component, pass onClick + ariaLabel to three StatCards: 'Upcoming festivals / आने वाले त्योहार' -> onGoto('festivals'); 'Discounted products / छूट वाले' -> onGoto('promotions'); 'Out of stock / स्टॉक खत्म' -> onGoto('promotions'). Leave 'Selected customers / चुने गए' without onClick (stays non-interactive). onGoto is the existing setSub callback already passed into Dashboard.

Create NEW file web/src/pages/admin/marketing/SuggestionNudge.tsx exporting a default React component MarketingSuggestionNudge with props { recommended: { festivalsSoon: any[]; discountedProducts: any[]; lowStock: any[] }; onGoto: (t) => void } (type recommended via the MarketingDashboard['recommended'] shape from ../../../lib/admin if convenient). Compute the suggestion first-match-wins: (a) a festival in festivalsSoon with festival_date within 7 days (today <= date <= today+7) -> '🎊 Aaj festival offer bhejein / Promote a festival offer today', action label '→ Festivals', action onGoto('festivals'); (b) else if discountedProducts non-empty -> '🏷️ Aaj apna top discount promote karein / Promote your top discount today', action onGoto('promotions'); (c) else if lowStock non-empty -> '📦 Ye items out of stock hain — restock ya customers ko bataayein / Some items are out of stock', action onGoto('promotions'); (d) else render null. Use a small local daysUntil-style date check (or import daysUntil if exported). Style with the inline design-system look (card, muted, btnPrimary/btnGhost) and include a tiny ✕ dismiss button.

Implement the nudge localStorage persistence in SuggestionNudge.tsx: key = `4astore_marketing_suggestion_${YYYY-MM-DD}` using LOCAL date; stored value JSON { state: 'actedOn' | 'dismissed' }. On mount: if key has state==='actedOn' render null (done for the day); otherwise show the nudge (whether absent or 'dismissed'). Action click -> write { state:'actedOn' } then call the action onGoto(...); it must not reappear that day. Plain ✕ close -> write { state:'dismissed' } and hide for this render but allow it to reappear on next mount/reload the same day. Wrap all localStorage reads/writes in try/catch for private-mode safety. No external deps.

In Dashboard(), render <MarketingSuggestionNudge recommended={d.recommended} onGoto={onGoto} /> at the very top of the Dashboard grid (above the StatCards), using the dashboard data `d` already loaded via useQuery(fetchMarketingDashboard).

In Dashboard(), add a compact primary-action CTA row near the top (below the nudge; above or beside the StatCards) with buttons reusing existing styles: '📣 Aaj ka offer bhejein' (btnPrimary) -> onGoto('promotions'); '🎊 Festival greeting' (btnGhost) -> onGoto('festivals'); '📤 Naya broadcast' (btnGhost) -> onGoto('broadcast'). Wrap in a flex container with gap:10 and flexWrap:'wrap' so they stack cleanly on mobile. Do NOT rename tabs, remove the free/manual model, or alter the header's 'Link khulna ≠ message bheja gaya / link opened ≠ sent' disclaimer.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\web exits cleanly (tsc -b typecheck + vite build pass) with no TypeScript errors.
StatCard with onClick renders role="button", is reachable by Tab, and fires its action on click and on Enter/Space; StatCards without onClick render as before (no role/pointer).
The three target StatCards deep-link: Upcoming festivals -> festivals tab, Discounted products -> promotions tab, Out of stock -> promotions tab; Selected customers remains non-interactive.

On the Dashboard, when festivalsSoon has a festival within 7 days the nudge shows the festival suggestion; otherwise it falls back to discount, then low-stock, then nothing — all from live data (no invented values).
Nudge Action marks the day actedOn (does not reappear on reload the same day); ✕ dismiss hides it but it reappears on reload the same day; state persists in localStorage keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.
The Dashboard shows the three CTA buttons which wrap on narrow widths and deep-link to promotions/festivals/broadcast; existing copy and disclaimer are intact.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\web and confirm a clean exit with no TS errors.

Manual visual check after build: click and keyboard-activate the three StatCards; trigger each nudge branch; confirm actedOn vs dismissed persistence across reload; confirm CTA buttons wrap and deep-link.
findings: Implemented. Files changed: web/src/pages/admin/AdminMarketing.tsx (StatCard now accepts optional onClick + ariaLabel; renders role=button, tabIndex=0, cursor pointer, hover boxShadow/transform, Enter/Space keydown with preventDefault on Space; no-onClick path unchanged. Dashboard wires 3 clickable StatCards + renders nudge at top of grid + CTA row) and NEW web/src/pages/admin/marketing/SuggestionNudge.tsx. Nudge localStorage key = `4astore_marketing_suggestion_${YYYY-MM-DD}` using LOCAL date (localDateKey() in SuggestionNudge.tsx), stored value JSON { state: 'actedOn' | 'dismissed' }; all reads/writes wrapped in try/catch. actedOn => hidden for the whole day across reload; dismissed => hidden this render only, reappears on reload same day. First-match-wins suggestion: (a) festival in festivalsSoon with daysUntil 0..7 -> onGoto('festivals'); (b) discountedProducts non-empty -> onGoto('promotions'); (c) lowStock non-empty -> onGoto('promotions'); (d) else null. SuggestionNudge DUPLICATES the SubTab union type and a local daysUntil() helper (daysUntil is not exported from AdminMarketing.tsx); it imports MarketingDashboard type from ../../../lib/admin for the `recommended` prop shape. CTA row targets: '📣 Aaj ka offer bhejein' btnPrimary -> 'promotions'; '🎊 Festival greeting' btnGhost -> 'festivals'; '📤 Naya broadcast' btnGhost -> 'broadcast'. StatCard deep-links: Upcoming festivals -> 'festivals', Discounted products -> 'promotions', Out of stock -> 'promotions'; 'Selected customers' left non-interactive. Header 'link opened != sent' disclaimer, tab names, and free/manual model all untouched. No new dependencies. Verification: `npm run build` in web/ exits 0 (tsc -b typecheck + vite build pass, no TS errors).
